deadline.value: Applications for Fall 2027 open October 15 and close December 15, 2026; documents (transcripts, ELP scores) by January 15, 2027. Fall intake only.
deadline.quote: October 15th - December 15th, 2026 - Applications Open | January 15th, 2027 - Documents such as transcripts, degree certificates, ELP tests should all be uploaded by this deadline

app_fee.quote: Yes, there is a non-refundable application fee of $135 CAD.

fee_waiver.value: The department funds fee waivers for a small number of applicants from underdeveloped countries (separate 2027/28 waiver application).
fee_waiver.quote: the Department of Computing Science may have some funding to support application fee waivers for a small number of students from underdeveloped countries

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required but highly recommended for degrees from outside Canada (strong applicants: Quant 155+, AWA 4.0+).
gre_general.quote: The GRE (General) is NOT required for application to our graduate programs, however it is highly recommended for applicants who have received their degree outside of Canada.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is required.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require the GRE Subject Test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 21 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 100 with a minimum score of 21 on each of the individual skill areas (internet-based), or equivalent

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum overall band score of 7.0 with a minimum score of 6.5 on each band

supervisor.value: Name up to 3 potential supervisors when applying; you are admitted only if a professor agrees to supervise.
supervisor.quote: Ph.D. applicants: | Are required to select a research area and name up to 3 professors as potential supervisors when applying. | Students will only be admitted if a professor agrees to supervise.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: Apply to the CS PhD and choose SML as your area; PhD applicants need an MSc in CS or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Students are accepted into the Ph.D. - Statistical Machine Learning (SML) program at admission time | Applicants for the Ph.D. in Computing Science must have an M.Sc. degree in Computing Science or a related field.

notes: Apply through the Computing Science PhD application and indicate SML as area of interest; transfer into SML later with supervisor support is also possible.
name: PhD - Statistical Machine Learning
